- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 90
- Description: Governance: payout Farm/Plot filter & cluster backfill — requirements, decisions, go-signals
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/blob/main/plans/PAYOUT_FARM_PLOT_FILTER_PLAN.md
  
  Details:
  Governor role on the payout Farm/Plot filter + cluster backfill effort (thread 38993).
  
  - Originated the requirement from a real operational need: back-record Paulo's (Fazenda Bom Sucesso) prior lump payment for ~10 trees so the trees show already-paid rather than outstanding — i.e. payouts by cluster, not one tree at a time.
  - Resolved the two blocking design/scope questions: (a) §1.3 "I did a one time amount for 10 trees" = the entered figure is the batch TOTAL, so each per-tree event carries total ÷ N; (b) approved the shared amount/paidAt/bankRef/receiptUrl for the cluster.
  - Provided the go-signals gating each phase: "go for it" (authorize plan execution), the ad-hoc "when I update farm, plot, program the URL should also update" (URL-sync feature), and the explicit "promote to prod" (PR3 always-stop prod gate).
  - Directs the final human step — beta UAT (§5 steps 2–3) and the live Paulo backfill — which moves money and therefore stays with the governor.
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
